description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential opportunity offers a chance to make a significant impact on patient care and facility success within a supportive environment.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of the facility's operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and fostering a positive and productive atmosphere for both residents and staff. This pivotal leadership role requires a visionary leader committed to excellence in long-term care.This full-time position offers a competitive annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000, reflecting your expertise and contributions. Join a team dedicated to providing high-quality care and achieving outstanding outcomes.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
Demonstrated ability to manage operations, staff, and financial performance
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $145,000, commensurate with experience.
